title: 2x Climbing Pole Bean ‘Kentucky Wonder’ Plug Plants – Heirloom, Rust Resistant,
description:
2x Climbing Pole Bean ‘Kentucky Wonder’ Plug Plants

A trusted and reliable

 heirloom variety

, producing vigorous, rust-resistant plants that thrive in a wide range of conditions. Grows to

 180–240 cm tall

and delivers heavy crops of

 18–22 cm pods

with exceptional flavour. The pods are oval, thick, gently curved, meaty, tender, and stringless when young. Perfect for eating fresh or freezing for later use.
